topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I just can't understand this sort of mess. I mean, I was on time, I did everything by the book. I triple-checked my bags, arrived hours early, and then, boom. Some invisible logistical hiccup and suddenly my plans are shattered. That event was a big deal, not just another item on a to-do list. And now it's gone, evaporated into the smog of poor planning or whatever excuse they'll feed me. I don’t want apologies; I don’t even know what I want at this point. Just for things to work as they should, for once. But here I am, stuck, with nothing to show for it.
